name: PoEtRy
author: Laazirfa
description: Skip the green orb at 21% to fall between the saw and the cube portal at 22% (you can hit the slope behind the green orb to make this more consistent). Time 3 clicks to get between the ball portal and the platform. Stay in the level until 31%, where you can fall above the level. Stay at a constant position above the level, except at 97%, where you need to land on the platform made of black blocks to complete the level.
